description.value:
The following modifications are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one, and you may install a modification the same moment you meet its prerequisites.

  • AI Amplifier (requires 5th level): +1 to melee tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • AI Rangefinder (requires 5th level): +1 to ranged tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Advanced Hardening (requires 15th level and Hardening): you gain resistance to ion damage.
  • Advanced Grounding System (requires 15th level and Prototype Grounding System): you gain resistance to lightning damage.
  • Advanced Jamming Phased Array (requires 15th level and Prototype Jamming Phased Array): while your jamming field is active, any hostile creature within it must succeed on a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to maintain concentration on a power.
  • Advanced Ionizing Phased Array (requires 15th level and Prototype Pulsating Phased Array): while your ionizing field is active, your tech powers and class features ignore resistance to ion damage, and creatures within the field treat immunity to ion damage as resistance instead; additionally, your Ionizing Phased Array feature now creates a fourth blast.
  • Advanced Targeting Phased Array (requires 15th level and Prototype Targeting Phased Array): while your targeting field is active, you can use an action to let a number of allies within it up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one) use their reactions to make a ranged weapon attack against a single target you can see. Usable again only after a short or long rest.
  • Droid Restraints: installing a restraining bolt takes half the normal time, and you may use your tech save DC for one you control if it would be higher than the item's own.
  • Flashlight Attachment: as a bonus action you toggle an attached light; while lit, the platform sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone.
  • Fadecasting Controller (requires 5th level): +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Strength or Constitution save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Grounding System: you have advantage on saves against lightning damage.
  • Hacked Communications: as a bonus action, choose any number of creatures within 60 feet that you can see carrying commlinks, headcomms, or similar devices; each must succeed on a Constitution save or take sonic damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one) and have its communication devices disabled until rebooted. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Hardening: you have advantage on saves against ion damage.
  • Intelligence Core Override (requires 9th level): you can cast override interface at 5th level without spending tech points; usable once per long rest.
  • Ionizing Phased Array (requires 5th level): while your ionizing field is active, you can use an action to make two ranged tech attacks (against the same target or different ones, each rolled separately) at targets within the field, dealing 1d6 ion damage on a hit.
  • Jamming Phased Array: while your jamming field is active, you can use an action to force a number of creatures within it who are concentrating on a power, up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), to make a Concentration save; if at least one loses concentration this way, you can use your reaction to deal ion damage equal to your Intelligence modifier to every creature that did.
  • Miniaturized Repulsor Coils: your platform can store 20 pounds of gear (no more than 1 cubic foot) without adding to your encumbrance.
  • Prototype Transmitter (requires 7th level): when you activate a field, you may double its radius. Usable once per long rest.
  • Prototype Grounding System (requires 7th level and Grounding System): you gain immunity to the shocked condition.
  • Prototype Jamming Phased Array (requires 7th level and Jamming Phased Array): while your jamming field is active, when a creature within it attempts to cast a tech power, you can use your reaction to cast tech override at 3rd level without spending tech points, adding your proficiency bonus to the techcasting ability check for that casting. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Prototype Ionizing Phased Array (requires 7th level and Ionizing Phased Array): while your ionizing field is active, casting a tech power or using a feature that affects others within the field lets you choose a number of them equal to 1 plus the power's level to automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage where a success would otherwise deal half; additionally, your Ionizing Phased Array feature now creates a third blast.
  • Prototype Targeting Phased Array (requires 7th level and Target Marking Phased Array): while your targeting field is active, you can use an action to cast scramble interface at 3rd level without spending tech points. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Redundant Circuits (requires 15th level): you can have two fields active at once.
  • Rendcasting Controller (requires 5th level): +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Dexterity or Intelligence save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Sensor Scramblers (requires 5th level): every creature within 10 feet of you, along with anything they're wearing or carrying, becomes undetectable to electronic sensors and cameras (though not to normal vision) for 10 minutes. Usable once per long rest.
  • Stealth Field Generator (requires 7th level): a portable cloaking device is built into the platform; activating or deactivating it is a bonus action, and while active for up to 1 minute you gain advantage on sight-based Dexterity (Stealth) checks, ending early if you attack or cast a force or tech power. Usable again only after a short or long rest.
  • Targeting Phased Array (requires 5th level): while your targeting field is active, you can use an action to force a number of creatures you can see within 60 feet, up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), to make a Dexterity save; on a failure, allies within your field have advantage on ranged weapon attacks against the target until the start of your next turn.
  • Truelight Attachment (requires 11th level and Flashlight Attachment): as a bonus action you activate a truesight mode for 1 minute, automatically dispelling illusions and detecting invisibility. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Withercasting Controller (requires 5th level): +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Wisdom or Charisma save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • X-Ray Targeting (requires 5th level): your weapon attacks and tech powers deal double damage against constructs.
